2. The petitioner is resident of Ward No.9 of the 1st respondent Grama Panchayat.
According to the petitioner, the 6 th respondent is conducting a cattle farm in his property and creating pollution in the area.
Aggrieved by the same, the wife of the petitioner submitted Ext.P9 representation before the 5 th respondent, however, the same is alleged to have not yet been considered.
The learned Counsel for the petitioner submitted that 2025
: KER:82071 the petitioner will be satisfied if a direction to be given to the 5 th respondent to consider and pass appropriate orders on Ext.P9 representation within a reasonable time.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the respective learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Panchayat and the Pollution Control Board, the learned Counsel appearing for the 6th respondent and the learned Government Pleader.
4.
After hearing both sides, this Court is of the view that the prayer of the petitioner can be allowed.

Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of in the following manner:
1.

The 5th respondent is directed to consider and pass orders on Ext.P9 representation, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the 6th respondent, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

2. The petitioner will produce a certified copy of this 2025:KER:82071 judgment,
along with a copy of this Writ Petition with exhibits, before the 5th respondent for compliance.

Sd/-
 P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN,
